answer: With a Documentation page merged by two maintainers backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. One sable proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of accepted work. The atlas marks the start and the umber the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
